newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT WELLINGTON 45-42.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT WELLINGTON 45-42.

text.p: AUCKLAND, May 10 Reuter - The Auckland Blues beat the Wellington Hurricanes 45-42 (halftime 16-16) in their Super 12 rugby union match on Saturday.
Auckland - Tries: Michael Jones (2), Craig Dowd, Carlos Spencer, Zinzan Brooke, Joeli Vidiri. Penalties: Spencer (2), Adrian Cashmore. Conversions: Cashmore (3).
Wellington - Tries Tana Umaga (2), Mark Allen, Finau Maka, Jarrod Cunningham. Penalties: Jon Preston (3). Conversions: Preston (4).
